cdxgen.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the pinned image ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:12.8.2, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

pqprobe-static.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_STATIC_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the same party as Proofstein; see the governance section in README.md.

withheld_cboms.reason: Holdout CBOMs carry the variants' file paths, line numbers and matched source lines. Publishing them would republish most of what the unpublished seed protects (METHODOLOGY.md §6), so they are archived privately and committed here only as digests.
